explanation: API lemma for erdosproblems.com/1115, where ℓ(r) is the length of the path Γ in the disc |z| < r. In Lean lengthInDisc γ r = volume {t ≥ 0 : ‖γ t‖ < r} for an arc-length-parametrised γ (so this is the length of Γ inside the open disc, counted with multiplicity), and the lemma states ℓ(r) ≤ ℓ(r') for r ≤ r'. This is the obvious monotonicity of ℓ, is mathematically correct, and is proved in the file by measure monotonicity. Faithful.
